Blind solve before opening key: Q1 I guessed Stan Winston (c), Q2=b, Q3=c, Q4=d, Q5=a, Q6=unsure (new film), Q7=c, Q8=d. Opened editorial.json after.

Q1 BLOCKING DEFECT (confirmed against primary/secondary sources, not fixed from v1's root concern): editorial names option a) Rick Baker as sole correct key. English Wikipedia's production background for 'The Autobiography of Miss Jane Pittman' states the aging transformation (ages 23–110) used 'realistic special effects makeup by Stan Winston AND Rick Baker' — a joint credit. Stan Winston's own Wikipedia bio confirms he won an Emmy specifically 'for 1974's The Autobiography of Miss Jane Pittman.' Rick Baker's filmography independently lists him as 'makeup creator: Miss Tyson' on the same film. So option c) Stan Winston, offered as a wrong distractor, is also a documented, Emmy-recognized credit on this exact production — this reproduces precisely the 'uniquely attributable' ambiguity Root flagged pre-rework, just with the labels swapped. Additionally the cited oscars.org source (https://www.oscars.org/news/studio-rick-baker-master-makeup) returns 403 live and has ZERO Wayback Machine snapshots ever; the real Academy Rick Baker bio page (oscars.org/collection-highlights/rick-baker) does not mention Miss Jane Pittman at all — the citation looks fabricated/unverifiable, not an opened source. The stem's '41-year-old Cicely Tyson' is also an unqualified fact where (a) Wikipedia's own account says age 23 at start, and (b) Tyson's real birth year/age was famously disputed for decades — exactly the 'disputed ages' risk the brief asked to preserve, not state flatly. Recommend: drop or substantially rewrite Q1, or restate as a two-credit fact with a genuinely distinguishing distractor set, backed by a real, opened citation.

Secondary concern (coverage/variety, not disclosed in coverage-notes.md): Q4 and Q5 both mine the identical single quote/paragraph on starwars.com about James Earl Jones and Vader's voice — verified accurate via direct fetch, but it's the same source and closely related knowledge point reused across 2 of 8 items. Q3 and Q7 both center on Moana (casting criteria vs. voice credit). Together 4 of 8 items cluster on just two character/franchise topics, undercutting the requested topical variety; coverage-notes.md does not disclose or justify this reuse.

Verified accurate via opened primary sources, no other issues found: Q2 (BFI 'John and Gena' — exact quote on Cassavetes shutting production for rewrites/rehearsals matches), Q3 (Disney 'brave, inquisitive, and confident' + strong singing matches exactly), Q4/Q5 (starwars.com direct quote on strict intonation boundaries + Lucasfilm crediting Jones matches exactly), Q6 (movies.disney.com/hoppers confirms Piper Curda as Mabel and the named distractor actors appear on the same page), Q7/Q8 are well-established, uncontroversial credits (Cravalho/Beatriz).
